about: Player-tunable settings. Each row becomes one field of the Settings struct, its INI read and its line in the shipped MojaveInSkyrim.ini.

columns.key: INI key (Hungarian prefix gives the type: b bool, i int, f float, s string)
columns.type: bool | int | float | string | pool (a music_pools.id)
columns.default: value when the INI line is missing
columns.about: comment written above the line in the INI

rows.about: Key that switches Radio New Vegas on and off, as a DirectInput scan code. 49 = N (free in Skyrim's default controls).
Radio loudness, times Skyrim's Master volume.
Chance that Mr. New Vegas introduces the next song.
Mr. New Vegas reads the news after this many songs. 0 = no news.
Mr. New Vegas says hello when you switch the radio on.
New Vegas music loudness, times Skyrim's Master and Music volumes.
How long one track fades into the next when the situation changes.
Skyrim hour when New Vegas's day versions start.
Skyrim hour when New Vegas's night versions start.
What plays for background music added by other mods (not in the mapping).
What plays for one-off stingers added by other mods.
Fade the New Vegas music and radio out while Skyrim isn't the active window.
Fallout: New Vegas folder. Empty = the one Melty passes in, else the one Steam registered.
Log every music decision to MojaveInSkyrim.log.
